name: Frostbite
description: Shows Frostbite's body temperature (Warm .. Freezing, the stages where its regeneration and damage debuffs start) and warming up / cooling down from the spot's temperature, and hides Frostbite's meter. Needs Frostbite enabled in its menu.

cold._: BodyTemp 1 = completely warm .. 0 = frozen, as cold 0 .. 100

stages._: _JSW_FB_RegenDebuff: no regeneration at this body temperature
_JSW_FB_DamageDebuff: the cold hurts at this body temperature

value._: the spot: -3 freezing, -2 cold, -1 cool, 0 neither, 1 comfortable, 2 warm (fire, warm interior)
